failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days increases, despite TRANSIT mobility falling by more than 5 points in the preceding week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days rises, even with a concurrent rise in RESIDENTIAL and fall in WORKPLACES mobility.

mechanism_narrative: The recent recovery trend in RETAIL_REC from t-3w to t-1w has been abruptly reversed by the latest week's data, suggesting a loss of consumer confidence or new restrictions that will drive RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC resumes its recovery trend and increases over the next 28 days, despite the recent week-on-week decline.
